Name: Farmhouse Retexture to match the weathered floor (path) (2)
Author: Lopoy20
Description:
This mod retextures the Farmhouse so that the porch wood matches the weathered floor (path), ive also made another version where the porch on the fully upgraded farmhouse is the same as the one in the farmhouse's second upgrade which you can find here (nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27040)

i made this because i was using the weathered floor path on my farm and wanted my farmhouse to match it, but I'm uploading it here incase anyone wants to do the same :)

this mod requires SMAPI and the content patcher

Manifest.Name: Weatheredpathhouseretex2
Manifest.Description: changes the house wooden porch to match the weathered path
Manifest.Author: Lopoy
